snippet.title: Kitsune Zero Consoles Trailer (Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, XBOX Series X|S)
snippet.description:
Kitsune Zero, prequel to the award winning queer platformer Kitsune Tails, is out now on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and XBOX Series X|S: https://kitsunegames.com/games/kitsunezero/

Read the announcement: https://kitsunegames.com/post/news/2026/11/19/kitsune-zero-out-on-consoles/
